args.brief: Chapter 3, "The Duplicate": Nadi reads the handling note and asks Sol about the missing second page of the flight register. The duplicate page arrives from Sol in a plain envelope — no letterhead, no stamp, folded twice — and Nadi notes that quietly without confrontation. Wren is free to disagree and does; Nadi weighs Wren's objection rather than overruling it. Precise practical actions: handling the envelope by its edges, laying the page flat under weights, noting fibres and fold lines, keeping the wooden sleeve closed and intact throughout. Third-person past, Nadi's viewpoint. No injury of any kind, no physical strain on the wooden sleeve. Ends with the shared agreement to continue checking before the demonstration.
